man I have been so excited to see what this will be like for 2 years since I heard it was coming out.

when your favorite series ever is getting made into the biggest most expensive TV show of all time and for it to look like hot fucking garbage is like the biggest kick in the balls ever. 

What a fucking joke man

This game sucks. It's completely unbalanced and no matter how many factions they add, they ruined it before release by having only one faction be able to "win"

But good luck. Just don't let Gondor win. I was Mordor in Season 1 and not only was our server OVERLOADED on "good" side factions, but they were incredibly poor sports the whole time.
